findings.detail: The position identifier includes parent schedule headers for investment class, country, and lien class before the issuer/instrument row.

rationale: PP01 is a real position-purity defect. The raw SOI separates parent headers from the issuer rows: table 8 row 2 is the debt-investments header, row 17 is the Switzerland header, row 18 is the lien-class header, and row 20 is the actual Esperanto BidCo AG position. The extracted bdc_investment_identifier concatenates those parent headers into the position identifier instead of preserving the issuer/instrument row as the identifier.
